📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +3.33%), C ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +21.94%) and FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.57% | 1M: +27.29%) are showing relative strength.
